question: If the Scrapingdog free credits do not renew, should the record's verdict be trial-only instead of fails-quota?
why: The verdict fails-quota holds either way (100 credits are 20 Google SERP Light requests), but trial-only describes a one-time 7-day allowance better than a recurring free plan; the choice waits on whether a free account's credits renew, which is behind a sign-up.
